title: Nan Can Not See the Cap
lines: Nan can not see the tan cap.
She can see lots of bags, but not the cap.
A dog sits at the pit.
"A cap is not a bed," said Nan.
Nan taps the dog. The dog hops up.
Nan pops the cap on and lets the dog up at the pit.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
